diagnostic: The focused CLI used node --input-type=module -e. Miniflare synchronous D1 RPC starts an eval Worker using require, which inherits --input-type=module and fails with require is not defined. The parent blocks in Atomics.wait before surfacing that Worker error. A separate Worker probe confirmed the cause. Use node -e with dynamic import, without --input-type; product/test files unchanged.
